subject: Compliance add-ons: packaging, pricing options, and volume discount request
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@wellkat.com>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@wellkat.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-ons: packaging, pricing options, and volume discount request

Hi Aisha / Michael —

Thanks for walking through WellKat's compliance checklist with us last week. Based on your notes (HIPAA, KMS/HSM-backed keys for ePHI, and 1yr audit-log retention with SSO + exports), I pulled together three packaging options so procurement can compare total cost and operational model. Attached: auditlog-pricing-sheet.csv and a draft SOW with addendum placeholders.

Quick summary (all numbers are monthly unless noted):
- Option A — Core + Audit-30: Audit logs retained 30 days, KMS (cloud-managed, BYOK support), no HSM. Add-on: $1,200/mo.
- Option B — Core + Audit-90 + KMS-HSM: 90-day retention, KMS integrated with HSM-backed key wrapping (shared HSM pool). Add-on: $3,900/mo.
- Option C — Full HIPAA Bundle: 365-day audit retention, dedicated HSM seats (optional), HIPAA addendum, SOC2 portability package, priority support. One-time onboarding fee: $35k; add-on: $9,000/mo.

Volume/commit note: we can extend a scaled discount on add-ons tied to a committed-months credit (12 or 24 months). For example, a 12-month commit reduces add-on unit prices by ~15%; 24-month by ~25%. I haven't committed concessions here yet — want to confirm WellKat's preferred term length and which option maps to your legal/security ask.

Can you confirm the following so I can produce a formal quote?
1) Preferred audit log retention tier (30 / 90 / 365 days).
2) HSM requirement: shared pool (lower cost) OR dedicated HSM seat(s) (higher cost). If dedicated, how many seats do you expect initially?
3) PO or internal procurement timeline for signature (target date).

If it helps, happy to jump on a 30-min call early this week to walk pricing line-by-line.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

Attachments: auditlog-pricing-sheet.csv, WellKat-SOW-draft-v1.pdf

From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@wellkat.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@wellkat.com>, procurement@wellkat.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: packaging, pricing options, and volume discount request

Hi Mina / Marissa —

Thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from our security and procurement teams:
- For audit logs: 90-day retention is our minimum for now; we may need to move to 365 in the future but would like to start with 90.
- KMS/HSM: We need HSM-backed key wrapping. Shared HSM pool is acceptable for an initial deployment, but security wants the option to convert to dedicated HSM seats within the first 6 months without re-keying (i.e., migration path).
- HIPAA: We will require a HIPAA addendum signed and an attestation of controls. The addendum template you attached looks fine but legal will redline.
- Budget: procurement asked for a run-rate estimate plus a bumped onboarding number to include migration validation testing.

Can you provide:
1) A 12-month and 24-month committed-term price for Option B (90 + shared HSM with conversion option) and Option C (Full HIPAA Bundle with 1 dedicated HSM seat)?
2) A one-line summary of what would trigger a charge when converting from shared HSM to dedicated seats (one-time rekey, seat reservation fee, etc.).
3) Any incumbent credits you can apply to offset onboarding (WellKat is evaluating final numbers before EOW).

Procurement looped in procurement@wellkat.com for timing. We can do a short call Wed morning PT if that helps.

Thanks,
Aisha Gupta
Head of Security Programs | WellKat Health
aisha.gupta@wellkat.com

---
(Quoted message)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Compliance add-ons: packaging, pricing options, and volume discount request

Team — forwarding WellKat's clarifications. High level asks: 90-day start, shared HSM with conversion option w/in 6 months, HIPAA addendum redlines expected, procurement wants onboarding buffer. They asked both 12mo and 24mo committed-term pricing for Option B and Option C and clarity on conversion charges.

Suggested concession: offer 18% on add-ons for 12mo commit and 28% for 24mo commit, plus waive up to $10k of the onboarding fee if they sign within 2 weeks. That keeps net onboarding revenue and gives procurement a credit they can measure.

If we want to be more aggressive, we could structure a usage-credit instead of onboarding waiver (preserves revenue recognition). Input from finance and legal on convert-to-dedicated HSM billing trigger needed — Dev, can you confirm what we would charge and the operations required for migration?

Mina

---
Forwarded content below.

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Compliance add-ons: packaging, pricing options, and volume discount request

Mina / team — technical/ops notes on HSM conversion:
- Conversion from shared HSM to a dedicated HSM seat requires a key-wrapping migration: we perform a rewrap operation which is a one-time task; there is no forced key rotation that affects customer keys other than the rewrap. Estimated effort: 8-16 engineer-hours for validation and a planned maintenance window.
- Charge model we recommend: one-time migration fee = $6,500 (covers cloud HSM provisioning, migration validation, and rewrap ops) + per-dedicated-seat reservation (if required) = $2,000/month per seat.
- For SLA/security attestation: we can provide a security runbook snapshot and test plan as part of onboarding; no additional charge.

I also confirm we can allow a 6-month window to convert without additional premium beyond the one-time migration fee. After 6 months, conversion will still be allowed but may require an additional seat setup lead time and pro-rated reservation charges.

Dev
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@wellkat.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: packaging, pricing options, and volume discount request

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the clear asks. Per Mina and Dev's recommendations, Redwood is able to offer the following commercial terms for Options B and C:

Option B (90-day + shared HSM with conversion):
- List add-on: $3,900/mo
- 12-month committed: $3,200/mo (18% off)
- 24-month committed: $2,800/mo (28% off)
- Conversion from shared to dedicated: one-time migration fee $6,500 (waived if signed 14 days after proposal)

Option C (Full HIPAA Bundle, 1 dedicated seat):
- List add-on: $9,000/mo + $2,000/mo per dedicated HSM seat
- 12-month committed: $7,380/mo (18% off on bundle)
- 24-month committed: $6,480/mo (28% off on bundle)
- Onboarding: one-time $35,000; offer to credit up to $10,000 against onboarding if they commit within 14 days.

Other commercial notes:
- We will include a HIPAA addendum template for legal review.
- SOC2 export and the 90-day retention are included in Option B; extending retention to 365 requires Option C or an add-on migration that we can price separately.
- Offer stands for 14 calendar days from today.

If these are acceptable, Mina — please send a formal quote and a DocuSign link; include an explicit line item for the conversion-migration fee and the onboarding credit.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: HIPAA-Addendum-template.docx

From: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@wellkat.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@wellkat.com>, procurement@wellkat.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: packaging, pricing options, and volume discount request

Marissa / Mina —

This looks good and aligned with what security wants. Procurement, please prepare a PO for the 12-month committed Option B pricing and include the waived migration fee as an item so finance can see the credit. We will circulate the PO and aim for signature next week; legal will send redlines to the HIPAA addendum by Thursday.

Mina — please send the formal quote and DocuSign link to procurement@wellkat.com and cc me / Aisha. I'll be the approval signer on the PO.

Thanks,
Michael O'Neill
VP of Technology | WellKat Health
